name: Relic Mod Manager
author: Relic Hunter
description: The mod manager for RuneScape: Dragonwilds, plus the shared parts every Relic mod uses. Shift+F7 opens and hides the window in game.

settings.label: Open at the main menu
settings.tooltip: Shows this window when the game reaches the main menu. Shift+F7 always opens it.

settings.label: Hide when a world loads
settings.tooltip: Tucks the window away when you load into a world, so the game gets your mouse and keyboard.

settings.label: Start the window with the game
settings.tooltip: Turn off to never start the Relic Mod Manager window. Your Relic mods still use their saved settings.
